page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at the top, page number at the top right. No marginal notes. A catchword at the lower right below the last line.

main_text.p: grum.Idem author libro quarto ,de re Me-dica,ubi de illo comitiali morbo , qui cau-sam habet melacholiam, in cerebri substantia,uerba facit, quemadmodum ex confe-quentibus,patet. Veratrum nigrū prodesse (inquit)comitialibus,melancholicis,insa-nientibus & cæteris.Senibus tamé & pue-ris exhibendum non esse, nec mollibus,& fœminis, animiq; debilibus, & multo ad-huc minus album, quòd uehementius & maiori cum periculo corpus euacuat. Ga-lenus quoq; ad epilepticos sua ꝑducit [?] re-media non aspernanda, nempe agaricum, radicem & fructum fefelis, ossa combusta, & maximè humana , mustela arefacta & sumpta.Recentem epilepsiam sanat Oribasius libro octauo ad Eustathium purgatio-ne per hieram facta: inueteratam uerò longo potu aquę,uel sanguinis misione: post medicamento purgante, nempe eleboro nigro,aut colocynthide, aut etiá scammo-nos.Sic & Aëtius,Sermone secundo,Tetr. 2.recetem profligat. Reuocatos autem ab insultu per hieram Galeni ex colocynthide purgat: inueteratos autem in longo aquæ potu cotinet, & in curationis aggres-sione,si nihil impedit mittit sanguinem:&

page.notes: Long s rendered as plain s throughout. Lines 3 and 4 of the final paragraph are partly obscured by a stain; "si nihil impedit mittit" and "sanguinem" are read with some doubt. "ꝑducit" after "sua" is doubtful and is marked [?]. "confe-" at the line break is read as printed, possibly "conse-". "cotinet" may carry a macron over the o that is not clearly visible. "recetem" and "2.recetem" are printed as they appear. The bottom-left corner shows only stains and is left out.
